title: On A. V. Anisimov's problem for finding a polynomial algorithm checking inclusion of context-free languages in group languages
summary: The work investigates the problem of whether a context-free language is a subset of a group language. A.~V. Anisimov has shown that the problem of determining the unambiguity of finite automata is a special case of this problem. Then the question of finding polynomial algorithm verifying the inclusion of context-free languages in group languages naturally arises. The article focuses on this open problem.
